summary: ```# Mesh Optimization and Retopology Toolset Tutorial Welcome to the tutorial on **Mesh Optimization** and **Retopology Toolset**. In this guide, we will explore various features that allow you to optimize mesh structures and customize topology effectively. ## Converting Pattern Mesh to Quadrangular Structure You can convert a pattern mesh to a quadrangular structure. Utilize the **Everywhere feature** to optimize the polycount. - **Target Polycount**: Type in the desired number for the Garmin and click the **Optimize** button. - The mesh will be updated, and you can see the new polycount number next to Garmin and in the statistics at the bottom left corner. ## Customizing Topology with the Retopology Toolset The **Retopology Toolset** allows you to fully customize the typology of the Garmin. ### Using the Patch Topology Tool - Create a patch with a set number of divisions using the **Patch Topology Tool**. - The patch is automatically created on the mirrored pattern, and you can connect multiple patches together. - Click the **Create** button to finish. Reference points are automatically generated based on the sewing relationship. ### Creating New Patterns To create a new pattern, use the **Create Topology Toolset**: 1. Draw quads and snap to the black reference points. 2. In the right-click menu of the **Edit Topology Tool**, you can find functions for **Add Subdivisions**. 3. You can draw and edit topology in both the 2D and 3D windows. ## Hotkeys for Efficient Workflow - The hotkey to switch to **Create Topology** and **Edit Topology Tools** is **U** and **Y** respectively. - Hold **Ctrl + Shift** and click with the **Create Topology Tool** to add an edge loop. ## Finalizing the Retopology After completing the retopology: - Right-click an empty space in the 2D window using the **Edit Topology Tool**. - You can choose to replace the original mesh with the retopologized mesh or create a duplicate. - After duplicating, the retopologized mesh will be created on top of the original mesh. ## Locking Remesh Patterns Use the **Transform Pattern Tool** to lock all remesh patterns. This feature allows you to easily separate the mesh from the original mesh in both the 2D and 3D windows. ## Exporting the Retopologized Mesh To export the retopologized mesh: 1. Go to **File > Export** and choose either **OBJ** or **FBX** file type. 2. In the export window, you will find the option for **Merge Vertex by Proximity**. When turned on, vertices within the set merge distance threshold will be merged. 3. This allows you to export and weld the mesh efficiently. You can visualize merged vertices in red and unmerged pattern border vertices in blue. ## Conclusion Thank you for following this tutorial on the Mesh Optimization and Retopology Toolset. By utilizing these tools, you can enhance your workflow and create more optimized meshes for your projects. ```
